content: Ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ Ɔdakɛ́ Mʋ Wie
Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɔtsʋn ayó ndɔ kʋtɔ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́. Akʋ́n dɛ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ, sʋ bɔpʋsáa ayó ámʋ kʋ wɩ́.
Farisifɔ akʋ bowun amʋ́, bɛbláa Yesu bɛɛ, “Kɩ, fʋ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋdɛ tɔ́á mbla mɛha ɔkpa bwɛ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́!”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩmɔ́kʋ́kla nu tɔ́á Owíe Dawid lɔ́bwɛ brɛ́á akʋ́n dɛ mʋa mʋ abúopʋ kɩ?
Olebitíwíé Bulu osúmkpa yótsu bodobodoá bapʋ́há Bulu igyí ba, mʋa mʋ abúopʋ amʋ begyi. Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ nkʋlɛ bɛha ɔkpa, bʋtegyi alɩ bodobodo amʋ.
Mlɩlakla Mose Mbla, nú ánɩ́ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ ámʋ bʋtɔyɔ́ agyʋ́má Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa ɩnʋ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́, támɛ bʋtamahá amʋ́ ɩpɔ́n.
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔdʋn Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa amʋ bʋ́ʋ nfɩ á.
Bulu asʋ́n lɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nwewúun ntekle, megyí igyíha.’ Nɩ́ mlɩyin mʋ́ asɩ á, tɛkɩ mlɩmɛ́ɛha ahá ánfɩ amʋ́ asʋ́n da ɔkpa ánfɩ ɩpɔ́n.
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ gyí ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ mʋ wie nɩ.”
Ɩlɔtsa Ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ Ɔdakɛ́
Yesu lɛ́natɩ́ ɩnʋ, ɔlɔyɔ Yudafɔ ofíakpa.
Olowun oyin ɔkʋá mʋ ɩbɩ kʋlɛ lawú ɩnʋ. Farisifɔ ámʋ bʋdɛ Yesu tɛ́ɛ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Mbla lɛha ɔkpa ánɩ́ bʋtsáa ɩlɔ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́?”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ bʋ kufa, alakpádá wíé ibúntɔ́ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ á, ɔmɛ́ɛlɛ mʋ?
Yɛ́ɛ nyankpʋsa bʋ labi dʋn kufa a? Mʋ́ sʋ mbla lɛha ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɔha ɔbɔ́bwɛ yilé ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa oyin ámʋ́ʋ́ mʋ ɩbɩ lawú ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tɩnkɩ fʋ́ ɩbɩ amʋ.” Olenya tɩ́nkɩ́ mʋ́ alɩ pɛ́, ɔŋɛ́ lowie mʋ́tɔ́ fɛ́ nyɔɔsɩ amʋ.
Támɛ mʋ́ ó á, Farisifɔ ámʋ bɛdalɩ yɛ́kɩtá agywɩɩn alɩá bɔ́bwɛ bɔ́mɔ Yesu.
Osúmbi Ánɩ́ Bulu Lɛ́lɛ
Yesu lɛ́bɩ amʋ́ agywɩɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ ɩnʋ. Ɔdɔm bobuo mʋ, ɔlɛtsa amʋ́tɔ́ alɔpʋ fɛ́ɛ́ ɩlɔ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛda amʋ́ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋmáha ahá abʋbɩ mʋ.
Ɩ́nɩ lɛ́ha asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yesaia lɛ́blɩ́ yáɩ́ ámʋ lɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́ nɩ́.
Ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: Ntɔdwɛ́ mʋ, mɩ ansɩ́ tegyi mʋ ɩwɩ.
Nɔ́pʋ mɩ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ wá mʋtɔ.
Ɔbɛ́bláa ɔmátɔ́fɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘négyi amʋ́ asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ.’
Obénya klʋn há ahá ánɩ́ amʋ́ hógyi ɔnɔ́ ma ɔnlɩn,
bábwɛ́ fɛ́ oyíá ɩlatá bia tá.
Ɔbɔ́wa awɩtɔlɛ há ahá ánɩ́ bʋma ɔwʋnlɩ́n,
bábwɛ́ fɛ́ ɔkandɩ́ɛá nfɔ latá mʋ́tɔ́,
yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á bɛ́bɩ ánɩ́ ntegyi asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ.
Ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ bɔ́pʋ ansɩ́ dɩ́nká mʋsʋ.”

content: Yesu Mʋa Beelsebul
Ɩnʋ bɔpʋ oyin ɔkʋ ba Yesu, ɔŋɛ laláhɛ bʋ mʋtɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɩlɛha mʋ ansíbi lobwie; álatɔ́ omúmu ɛ́. Yesu lɛ́tsa mʋ ɩlɔ, ɔdɛ atɔ́ wúun, ɔdɛtɔɩ́ ɛ́.
Ɔnɔ́ lobwie ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́, bɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Megyí Dawid mʋ na ámʋ nɩ?”
Támɛ Farisifɔ ámʋ bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ á, bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Ɔŋɛ laláhɛ owíe Beelsebul túmi ɔ́dɛpʋgya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɛ́ ahátɔ.”
Yesu lɛ́bɩ amʋ́ agywɩɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Iwíe ogyíkpá ánɩ́ ɩlaye anyɔ, bʋdɛ aba kɔ bɛ́dɩda. Alɩ kɛ́n wúlu ntɛ́ɛ wóyí oduá mʋ́tɔ́ atsiápʋ́ bʋdɛ aba kɔ ɛ́ itobwíé nɩ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ Ɔbʋnsám dɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ gyáa a, mʋ iwíegyí bɛ́dɩda.
Nɩ́ Beelsebul túmi ndɛpʋgya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɛ́ ahátɔ á, mʋ́mʋ́ ma túmi mlɩ abí ɛ́ bʋdɛpʋgya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ lɛ́ ahátɔ? Mlɩ abí ámʋ onutó obégyi mlɩ asʋ́n.
Támɛ ɩ́nɩá Bulu Ɔŋɛ́ ndɛpʋgya ɔŋɛ laláhɛ sʋ á, mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ laba mlɩ wá dodo.”
Ɔhaa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ wíé ɔwʋnlɩ́npʋ́ wóyítɔ́ yɔ́kʋlá mʋ atɔ́, nkɛ́tɩ alagyankpá kɩ́klɩ mʋ tswɩ, asa ɔbɛ́talɩ́ kʋ́lá mʋ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Ɔhá ánɩ́ omobuo mɩ dɛ́ mɩ́ lu. Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɛdɛ́ mɩ́ tsa akpa ahá ba Bulu ɛ́ dɛ́ amʋ́ gyáa tɛɩ́a mɩ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, Bulu obési ahá lakpan pʋ́ abususʋ kugyíkʋ kíé amʋ́. Támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔblɩ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ ɩwɩ abususʋ a, Bulu méesikíé mʋ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.

Nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́blɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛ́ ɩwɩ asʋn laláhɛ a, Bulu ɔbɛ́talɩ́ sikíé mʋ. Támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́blɩ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ ɩwɩ asʋn laláhɛ mʋ́ á, Bulu méesikíé ɔhá ámʋ ndɛ ɔyɩ kɛhɛ, ntɛ́ɛ brɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbá ámʋtɔ.
Tsiátɔ́ Itsú Ɩklʋntɔ
Oyí abí bʋtɔpʋ́bɩ́ mʋ́. Oyi wankláán toswíé abi wankláán. Oyi laláhɛ ɛ́ toswíé abi laláhɛ.
Mlɩ awɔ abí-aná! Nkálɩ mlɩ aha laláhɛ mlɛ́talɩ́ blɩ́ asʋn wankláán? Tsúfɛ́ tɔ́á ɩdʋn ɔha klʋn a, mʋ́tɛ́dálɩ tsu mʋ ɔnɔ́.
Ɔha wankláán tɛblɩ́ asʋn wankláán tsú mʋ klʋntɔ, ɔha laláhɛ ɛ́ tɛblɩ́ asʋn laláhɛ tsú mʋ klʋntɔ.
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, ɔhagyíɔha ɔbɛ́lɛ asʋn laláhɛ kugyíkʋá ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔnɔ́ Bulu asʋ́n ogyíkɛ́ amʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔha asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ Bulu ɔbɔ́pʋhá mʋ asʋ ntɛ́ɛ ɩpɔ́n.
Bodunká Ofúla
Mʋ́ʋ́ Farisifɔ pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ amʋ akʋ bɛbláa Yesu bɛɛ, “Osunápʋ́, anɩdéklé anɩaa fʋbwɛ́ɛ osúna kʋ suna anɩ.”
Ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ “Mlɩ ndɛmba-abí laláhɛ ánɩ́ mlɩladálɩ Bulu ɔma. Mlɩdɛ́ osúna dunká amlɩwun, támɛ mlɩmóowun kʋkʋʋkʋ dʋn Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yona osúna amʋ.
Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ Yona létsiá bonsu ɩwɩtɔ nkɛnsá, ɔpa mʋ́a onyé ámʋ a, alɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɛ́ nétsiá ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ ɔtɔ́tɔ́ nkɛnsá, ɔpa mʋ́a onyé nɩ́.

Niniwefɔ ɛ́ bɔ́kʋsʋ́ Bulu asʋ́n ogyíkɛ́ amʋ, há mlɩ ndɛmba-abí ánfɩ ɩpɔ́n. Tsúfɛ́ brɛ́á Yona lɛ́da Bulu asʋ́n ɔkan súná amʋ́ á, bɛdamlí klʋntɔ ba Bulu wá. Mlɩkɩ, ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔdʋn Yona onutó lɩ́ɩ́ nfɩ á.

Seba owíe tsɩhɛ́ ɔbɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ Bulu asʋ́n ogyíkɛ, há mlɩ ndɛmba-abí ánfɩ ɩpɔ́n. Tsúfɛ́ olotsu ɔsaasɩ́ ɔmá ɩkʋtɔ kéín gya ɔkpa ba, bonu Salomo nyánsa atosunáhɛ́. Mlɩkɩ, ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔdʋn Salomo lɩ́ɩ́ nfɩ á.”
Ɔŋɛ Laláhɛ Yinkí Ba Ɔhatɔ
“Nɩ́ ɔŋɛ laláhɛ ɩdálɩ ɔhatɔ á, iteyéki dimbísʋ́ dúnká ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakpá, támɛ ɩtamanyá.
Ɩnʋ ɩtɛblɩ́ ánɩ́ ibéyinkí yɔ́ mʋ́ wóyí dadatɔ. Nɩ́ ɩsánkí yɔ́ á, itowun ánɩ́ bafɛ́ɩ́ mʋ́tɔ́, lá mʋ́tɔ́ wankláán, ɩda kpan.
Iteyínkí yɛ́kpa mʋ́ aba asienɔ́ ánɩ́ bʋtɔbwɛ́ lalahɛ dʋn mʋ́, bʋtɛba betsiá ɩnʋ. Ɩnʋ ɔhá ámʋ tsiátɔ́ teyíntá dʋn alɩá igyi yáɩ́. Alɩ́ ɩbɛ́ba ha mlɩ ndɛmba-abí laláhɛ anfɩ nɩ́.”
Yesu Abusuanfɔ Onutó
Brɛ́á Yesu trá ɔdɛ ahá ámʋ asʋ́n bláa a, mʋ yin mʋa mʋ apíó bɛba bɛlɩɩ́ kpankpá, bʋdedunká ánɩ́ bɛ́bláa mʋ asʋ́n.
Ahá ámʋtɔ ɔkʋ lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Kɩ, fʋ́ yín mʋa fʋ́ apíó bʋlɩɩ́ kpankpá. Bʋdɛ fʋ́ dunká, abʋbla fʋ asʋ́n.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Amɛndɩ gyí mɩ́ yín mʋa mɩ́ apíó?”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛtɩnkɩ́ ɩbɩ sɩ́sɩ́ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkɩ, mɩ́ yín mʋa mɩ́ apíó gyí ahá ánfɩ á.
Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔtɔbwɛ́ mɩ́ Sɩ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbʋ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ ámʋ apɛ́ á, mʋgyí mɩ́ yín mʋ́a mɩ́ píó nɩ́.”
